column1: # figure: Fig. 4 panel, freshly resected against postmortem (Liharska et al. 2025, Mol Psychiatry, doi 10.1038/s41380-025-03163-1), per-gene scatter over the 383 recurrent genes

# script: fig4_liharska_per_gene_2026-10-19/build_liharska_per_gene.py, run 2026-10-19; loaders and rules reused from liharska_living_vs_pm_2026-10-18/scripts/s1_main.py (best row per symbol by smallest P; Ensembl ids mapped through HGNC)

# input: liharska_living_vs_pm_2026-10-18/data/liv_pm_de_ST1.tsv sha256 d8a4171a6329 (Liharska Supplementary Table 1, MOESM8: per-gene moderated t of postmortem against living prefrontal cortex); data/collado_torres/TableS4.csv sha256 5024842c8776 (Collado-Torres et al. 2023, living_brain_reanalysis, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.10010510: the same contrast without and with quality surrogate variables, qSVA)

# input: recurrence_on_80_studies/out/recurrence_genes.tsv sha256 dda5eb621c15 (383 genes; sz_direction = sign of n_up - n_down lists); figure_data_core80_2026-10-17/fig07/fig07_a2_a4_gene_scatter.tsv sha256 0c7508208dc0 (z_sz_raw: Stouffer z of the schizophrenia effect, same z used elsewhere in Fig. 4); ph_axis_from_ten_dataset_regions/axis_v2_controls.tsv.gz sha256 2c72a9b279a2; analyses/gtex_ischemia_2026-10-08/hardy_t_by_region.tsv.gz sha256 54f989c55753; data/reference/hgnc_complete_set.txt via extract.py

# sign conventions: liv_pm_t positive = higher in postmortem, negative = higher in freshly resected (living) tissue; liv_pm_t_with_qsva is the same contrast after adjusting for quality surrogate variables from a degradation experiment (Collado-Torres 2023) and removes most of the signal by construction; ph_axis_v2_z positive = higher at higher brain pH (control-only, ten dataset-regions); agonal_axis_t positive = higher after slow death (mean over BA9, BA24, Cortex of GTEx slow-minus-fast natural death t); z_sz_raw positive = higher in schizophrenia

# in_374_with_direction = gene has an SZ direction (up or down) and a Liharska statistic; liv_pm_in_sz_direction = sign(liv_pm_t) equals the SZ direction; blank where a gene has no direction or no statistic; genes without a value are blank (not measured in that source)
